end.summary: Discussed physical and chemical changes using ghee melting, roti baking, and rusting.
end.parentNote: Ananya practised identifying physical changes by checking whether a new substance forms and whether the change can be reversed. They reasoned through ghee melting and rusting, including the difference between covering rust with paint and removing it. The definition and examples still need another guided review; at home, ask Ananya to sort everyday examples into physical or chemical changes and explain whether a new substance forms.
